title: TikTok agrees to settle three more teen social media lawsuits ahead of trial; 2,600 cases with similar claims are pending in California federal court (Dietrich Knauth/Reuters)
summary: Dietrich Knauth / Reuters: TikTok agrees to settle three more teen social media lawsuits ahead of trial; 2,600 cases with similar claims are pending in California federal court — TikTok has agreed to settle three lawsuits brought by young people who accuse social media companies of designing their platforms …
